fact: 到1930年底，英国失业人数从100万增至250万（占投保劳动力的比例从12%升至20%），出口值下降50%。当时几乎没有失业救济，大规模失业直接把大量人口推向贫困；政府收入随国民收入下降而收缩，救济支出却上升。工业区与产煤区受冲击最重，伦敦与东南部受损较轻。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Great Depression in the United Kingdom
sources.quote: By the end of 1930, unemployment had more than doubled from 1 million to 2.5 million (from 12% to 20% of the insured workforce), and exports had fallen in value by 50%. During this time there were little to no unemployment benefits, so this mass unemployment led to many of Britain's population becoming impoverished.

fact: 1925年4月，财政大臣丘吉尔在英格兰银行建议下把英镑恢复到战前金平价1英镑兑4.86美元，使英镑可兑换黄金；但该平价使黄金价格被高估10%—14%，煤炭与钢铁出口因此失去竞争力。为抵消高汇率，出口行业试图通过降低工人工资来削减成本。整个1920年代失业稳定在100万左右，工业区在1920年代余下的时间里一直处于衰退，投资与现代化都很少。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Great Depression in the United Kingdom
sources.quote: in April 1925, the Conservative Chancellor of the Exchequer, Winston Churchill, on advice from the Bank of England, restored the Pound Sterling to the gold standard at its postwar exchange rate of $4.86 US dollars to one pound. ... The price of gold was over-estimated by 10–14% leading to coal and steel as an export becoming less competitive. ... Throughout the 1920s, unemployment stayed at a steady one million.

fact: 1931年7月的《梅报告》（May Report）建议削减公共部门工资与大幅削减公共开支以避免预算赤字，方案为对富人增税2400万英镑、节约9600万英镑，其中6400万英镑来自失业救济。该方案在工党与工会内部极不受欢迎，多名大臣拒绝支持；财政大臣斯诺登坚持采纳。1931年9月英国放弃金本位，英镑汇率随即从4.86美元跌至3.40美元，贬值25%，英国出口竞争力因此改善，为逐步复苏奠定基础。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Great Depression in the United Kingdom
sources.quote: The May Report of July 1931 urged public sector wage cuts and large cuts in public spending (notably in benefit payments ("dole") to the unemployed) to avoid incurring a budget deficit. ... the proposal was to meet £24 million by increased taxes on the rich, and £96 million by economies, of which £64 million would come from unemployment relief. ... Immediately the exchange rate of the pound fell by 25%, from $4.86 for one pound to $3.40.

fact: 1930年1月，初级大臣奥斯瓦尔德·莫斯利提出备忘录，主张政府控制银行与出口、提高养老金以扩大购买力。建议被拒后，他退出工党，组建新党（New Party），后来转向英国法西斯联盟。这条线索说明1930年英国的主流应对是紧缩与平衡预算，主张扩张性政策的人在政治上被边缘化。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Great Depression in the United Kingdom
sources.quote: In a memorandum in January 1930, one junior government minister, Oswald Mosley, proposed that the government take control of banking and exports, as well as increase pensions to boost purchasing power. When his ideas were turned down, he left Labour to form the New Party, and later the British Union of Fascists.

fact: 「帝国自由贸易运动」（Empire Free Trade Crusade）由比弗布鲁克勋爵于1929年7月创立，主张把英帝国建成排他性的自由贸易集团、对 rival 贸易集团设置高壁垒。1930年4月16日其青年组织「青年十字军」在伦敦成立；1930年10月，该运动候选人欧内斯特·泰勒在帕丁顿南区补选中击败保守党，赢得原属保守党的安全席位。这场运动把「帝国特惠」从关税技术问题推成了1930年英国最热的政治议题之一。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Empire Free Trade Crusade
sources.quote: The Empire Free Trade Crusade was a political party in the United Kingdom. It was founded by Max Aitken, 1st Baron Beaverbrook in July 1929 to press for the British Empire to become a free trade bloc. ... A party youth group for under-25s, the Young Crusaders, was launched on 16 April 1930 in London. ... In October 1930, Ernest Taylor stood for the party in the Paddington South by-election, winning a previously safe Conservative seat.

fact: 1930年英国失业者主要依靠地方政府的救济（dole），而「几乎没有失业保险」；在部分工业区失业率在1930年代初达到70%，全国超过300万人失业，许多家庭完全依赖地方救济。1933年格拉斯哥30%的人口失业。这意味着1930年英国的生存成本问题不是物价，而是现金收入的中断与救济资格的地方化差异。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Great Depression in the United Kingdom
sources.quote: Unemployment reached 70% in some areas at the start of the 1930s (with more than 3 million out of work nationally) and many families depended entirely on payments from local government known as the dole. ... In 1933, 30% of Glaswegians were unemployed due to the severe decline in heavy industry.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Great Depression in the United Kingdom，救济段落
sources.quote: During this time there were little to no unemployment benefits, so this mass unemployment led to many of Britain's population becoming impoverished.

fact: 1930年英国的经济法律框架由两件事锁定：一，1925年恢复的金本位使英镑与黄金按4.86美元固定，货币政策必须服从汇率；二，1932年渥太华协定后，财政大臣内维尔·张伯伦对工业与农产品进口普遍征收10%关税，但英帝国成员国的商品除外。这一「对外关税＋帝国内部特惠」的结构在1930年尚在辩论中（帝国自由贸易运动正推动更激进的版本），1932年才落地。关税的引入还导致自由党分裂，部分自由党人与斯诺登撤回了对国民政府的支持。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Great Depression in the United Kingdom
sources.quote: Also, in 1932 following the Ottawa Agreement, Neville Chamberlain, who had become Chancellor after the 1931 election, introduced tariffs on industrial and agricultural imports at a rate of 10% on all imports except those from the countries of the British Empire. The introduction of tariffs caused a split in the Liberal Party, some of whom, along with Phillip Snowden, withdrew support for the National Government.

fact: 1930—1931年英国面临持续的黄金外流，财政部最终于1931年9月被迫放弃金本位。此前政府一直接受正统政策：平衡预算、维持金本位。放弃金本位后并未出现预期的灾难，反而成为重大优势——英镑贬值25%使出口更具竞争力，为渐进复苏奠定基础。这一结果与当时主流判断相反，是1930年代英国政策转折的关键。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Great Depression in the United Kingdom
sources.quote: The flight of gold continued, however, and the Treasury finally was forced to abandon the gold standard in September 1931. Until now the government had religiously followed orthodox policies which demanded balanced budgets and the gold standard. Instead of the predicted disaster, cutting loose from gold proved a major advantage.

fact: 1930年英国工业呈明显的二元结构：煤炭、造船、钢铁等出口导向的重工业高度集中在英格兰北部、南威尔士、北爱尔兰与苏格兰中部，与大陆竞争对手相比规模更小、设备更不现代、效率更低、人员过剩；新产业则集中在英格兰南部与中部。西北部（曼彻斯特与兰开夏）纺织业萧条，南威尔士谷地的梅瑟蒂德菲尔与斯旺西失业率一度超过25%。1929—1933年英国重工业产出下降三分之一，世界贸易减半。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Great Depression in the United Kingdom
sources.quote: Heavy industries which formed the bedrock of Britain's export trade (such as coal mining, shipbuilding and steel) were heavily concentrated in certain areas of Britain, such as northern England, South Wales, Northern Ireland and central Scotland, while the newer industries were heavily concentrated in southern and central England. ... Staple industries such as coal, steel and shipbuilding were smaller, less modern and efficient and over-staffed compared to continental rivals. ... towns such as Merthyr Tydfil and Swansea had unemployment rates reaching above 25% at certain times.

fact: 与出口部门相反，英国住宅建筑在萧条期逆势扩张：1929至1933年新建住宅数量增长33%，同期利润、物价、出口量与出口值、进口量均下降。1929—1933年总就业仅降至1929年的94.9%，实际国民收入与工资呈正向趋势；伦敦及周边地区的普通人并未经历严重困苦，部分人生活还有改善。这说明1930年英国存在两个几乎相反的经济体：出口重工业区与南部内需型建筑业。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Great Depression in the United Kingdom
sources.quote: New houses built increased by 33% from 1929 to 1933, while profits, prices, export volume and value, and imports volume and value dropped. ... from 1929 to 1933 employment dipped only to 94.9% relative to 1929 employment metrics and recovery was seen as early as 1933 ... the common person especially in areas around London did not experience major hardship and even prospered.
